title: Alibaba in the Spotlight as Cloud and AI Interest Peaks in Canada
description: Alibaba, a leading cloud and AI company, is trending in Canada as per Google Trends data. The tech giant is being compared with Oracle in terms of investment potential, and has recently partnered with Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 for Day 0 support.

sections.heading: Alibaba's Market Comparison
paragraphs: Zacks Investment Research has published an article comparing Alibaba with Oracle, discussing which of the two cloud and AI giants is a better investment option right now.

sections.heading: Alibaba Cloud Partnership
paragraphs: Alibaba Cloud has secured Day 0 support for Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, as reported by digitimes. This partnership signifies Alibaba's continued expansion in the AI and cloud computing sectors.

sections.heading: AI and GPU Advancements
paragraphs: AIBase reports that Alibaba's Hygon DCU has demonstrated the ability to adapt to Kimi K3 896's expert parallelism without lag, highlighting the company's advancements in domestic GPUs and their capability to run large models.

faq.q: Why is Alibaba trending in Canada?
faq.a: Alibaba is trending in Canada due to increased interest in cloud and AI technologies, as indicated by Google Trends data.

faq.q: What is Alibaba Cloud's recent partnership?
faq.a: Alibaba Cloud has partnered with Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 to provide Day 0 support, as reported by digitimes.
